description: This file contains Scala source code defining classes and methods for integrating Kinesis data streams with Apache Spark. It includes classes for representing sequence number ranges, partitions, RDDs backed by Kinesis, and iterators for fetching data from Kinesis with retry logic.

classes.name: SequenceNumberRange
classes.description: Represents a range of Kinesis sequence numbers with associated stream, shard, and record count.

classes.name: SequenceNumberRanges
classes.description: Encapsulates a sequence of SequenceNumberRange objects, providing utility methods.

classes.name: KinesisBackedBlockRDDPartition
classes.description: Partition class storing block ID and sequence number ranges for Kinesis-backed RDD.

classes.name: KinesisBackedBlockRDD
classes.description: RDD class where data blocks are backed by Kinesis streams, supporting fetching data via sequence numbers.

classes.name: KinesisSequenceRangeIterator
classes.description: Iterator fetching Kinesis records within a specified sequence number range, with retry logic.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the sequence number ranges are empty.

methods.name: nonEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the sequence number ranges are non-empty.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Creates an array of partitions for the Kinesis-backed RDD.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Fetches data for a given partition, either from block manager or directly from Kinesis.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next Kinesis record within the specified range, handling retries and end conditions.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Fetches records starting from a specific sequence number.

methods.name: getRecordsAndNextKinesisIterator
methods.description: Fetches records and the next shard iterator, with de-aggregation.

methods.name: getKinesisIterator
methods.description: Obtains a shard iterator for a given sequence number and iterator type.

methods.name: retryOrTimeout
methods.description: Retries Kinesis API calls with exponential backoff and timeout handling.
